name: weedMap: Large-Scale Aerial Multispectral Weed Mapping Dataset
description: weedMap is an open-access aerial multispectral weed mapping benchmark collected using autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with multi-spectral sensors (green, red, red-edge, and near-infrared channels) over agricultural fields in Switzerland and Germany. Curated by the Autonomous Systems Lab at ETH Zurich and the University of Bonn, the dataset includes calibrated multispectral orthomosaics and 11,000+ tile patches annotated across sugar beet, sunflower, soil, and weed classes, providing a standard testbed for automated weed mapping and targeted herbicide application.
